A.strength: Editorial hairline/clip-path system executes every anchor — exact palette, order, placeholders, zero invented facts — with genuinely distinctive restraint.
A.weakness: Orange leaks into decorative eyebrows, step numerals and slashes beyond 'action lives', and there's no sticky header or mobile nav for the urgent visitor.

B.strength: Best conversion apparatus — sticky orange phone header, 24/6 topstrip, custom line-animal icons and strong conversational microcopy.
B.weakness: Fabricates what the brief forbids (10-city service list, 'within the hour' response claims, 'backed in writing'), uses banned-adjacent red validation and animates the 'no animation' emergency band.

C.strength: Strictest discipline in the set: orange only on actions, explicit placeholder labeling, sentence-case rigor, static emergency band, no invented claims.
C.weakness: Layout craft is the plainest — simple tiles, centered commercial block and fewer memorable compositional moments risk reading under-designed.

notes: A wins on craft-plus-fidelity, C trades polish for the cleanest contract compliance, B converts best but its invented facts and accent drift breach explicit anchors.
